name: patch_moves_3
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
src=open('src/ZeckMoves.lean').read()
src=src.replace('''  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 1 + 1
  · subst h1; simp
  · by_cases h3 : t = i' + 1
    · subst h3; simp
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp
      · simp [h1, h3, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h3, Ne.symm h4]''','''  have a1 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m = m + 1 + 1 := fun m => by omega
  have a2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m + 1 + 1 = m := fun m => by omega
  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 1 + 1
  · subst h1; simp [a1, a2]
  · by_cases h3 : t = i' + 1
    · subst h3; simp [a1, a2]
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp [a1, a2]
      · simp [h1, h3, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h3, Ne.symm h4]''')
src=src.replace('''  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 2 + 1
  · subst h1; simp
  · by_cases h2 : t = i' + 2
    · subst h2; simp
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp
      · simp [h1, h2, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2, Ne.symm h4]''','''  have a1 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m = m + 2 + 1 := fun m => by omega
  have a2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m + 2 + 1 = m := fun m => by omega
  have a3 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m = m + 2 := fun m => by omega
  have a4 : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ m + 2 = m := fun m => by omega
  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 2 + 1
  · subst h1; simp [a1, a2, a3, a4]
  · by_cases h2 : t = i' + 2
    · subst h2; simp [a1, a2, a3, a4]
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp [a1, a2, a3, a4]
      · simp [h1, h2, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2, Ne.symm h4]''')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/ZeckMoves.lean'],input=src,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
